frame: Provisional frame: x forward, y to port, z up, metres. Origin x=0 at the stem (forward end of LOA, which is also the forestay deck point since SFJ=0), so points aft of the stem have negative x. y=0 on the centreline. z=0 on the ORC measurement-trim flotation plane (no crew, no sails), the plane the certificate freeboards are measured from. A later hull-morph task moves the origin to DWL midship. Sail positions are in the boat's centreplane (y = 0) as for an unsheeted sail; mast assumed vertical.

area_formulas.value: ORC Rating Systems 2019 rule 109.1 (main measured area) and 111.1/111.2 (headsail measured area and default widths)
area_formulas.note: The certificate does not measure HQW, HTW or HUW for the jib. Rule 111.2 sets them for a headsail without leech roach (class G.4.1(d): leech not convex): HQW = 0.75 HLP + 0.25 HHB, HTW = 0.25 HLP + 0.75 HHB, HUW = 0.125 HLP + 0.875 HHB.

luff_max.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), C.8.1 mast band distance; ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.1
luff_max.note: The head may not be set above the upper band, so luff length is at most P.

foot_max.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), C.8.2 boom band distance; ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.1

leech_max.note: 9780 mm. The P x E box with MHB would give 9.846 m, so a class sail sits slightly inside the bands.

mhb.note: top width. Conflicts with the class maximum of 152 mm (G.3.3); the certificate value is used because it reproduces the certificate area.

area.note: Measured area 20.91; rated Area (r) 21.53; p.3 inventory lists 20.92.

tack.method: aft face of mast (x = -(J + MDL1)) at boom band height (freeboard at mast + BAS).

head.method: tack + P straight up the aft face; vertical mast assumed.

clew.method: tack + E aft along a horizontal boom.

sheet_point_on_boom.method: mainsheet strop position scaled from the J/Boats profile (3.03 m aft of the mast aft face), on the underside of the boom.

traveler_centre.source: J/Boats J/80 deck plan drawing (J80-Plan-700.png); J/Boats J/80 rig profile drawing (J80-Rig-700.png)
traveler_centre.method: x: mean of the plan drawing (-6.25 m) and the vertical mainsheet on the profile (-6.05 m). z: lower mainsheet block on the profile.

traveler_span.method: track length across the cockpit scaled from the J/Boats deck plan; centred on y = 0.

sheet_purchase.value: 5:1 or 6:1 coarse, at most 12:1 with fine tune

hhw.note: half width. Class maximum is 1475 mm (G.4.2); the certificate rounds to 0.01 m.

area.source: ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.1; ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.3

battens.note: at most three furlable leech battens

tack.source: ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.1; ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.3
tack.method: at the forestay deck point; the ORC p.3 drawing puts the tack on the sheer at the stem. Furler drum height is not modelled.

head.source: ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.1; ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.3
head.method: tack + HLU along the line from the forestay deck point to the hounds.

clew.method: scaled from the ORC p.3 sail plan at 110.9 px/m. Check: its perpendicular distance to the luff is 2.949 m against HLP 2.95 m.

foot.method: distance tack to clew from the positions above.

leech.method: distance head to clew from the positions above.

track_length.note: two anodised T-tracks, 1 m x 25 mm; car position optional

track_fwd_end.source: J/Boats J/80 deck plan drawing (J80-Plan-700.png); J/Boats J/80 rig profile drawing (J80-Rig-700.png); J/80 Standard Building Specifications (1-Dec-20)
track_fwd_end.method: the slot drawn on the cabin top spans x -3.87 to -3.34 m (0.53 m) in the J/Boats plan; a 1 m track (building spec) is centred on it. y scaled from the plan, z is the cabin-top height scaled from the profile. Mirror y for starboard.

track_aft_end.source: J/Boats J/80 deck plan drawing (J80-Plan-700.png); J/Boats J/80 rig profile drawing (J80-Rig-700.png); J/80 Standard Building Specifications (1-Dec-20)
